# Airways Aviation

> > World-class EASA and CASA-certified pilot training, cabin crew, and aircraft maintenance programs delivered across 10+ international locations with advanced flight simulators and Diamond Aircraft fleet.

Airways Aviation is a global aviation training organization offering comprehensive pilot education, cabin crew training, and aircraft maintenance courses through EASA-approved academies in Europe, Australia, UAE, India, and Africa. The organization operates multiple training centers including the flagship ESMA academy in Montpellier, France, and partners with leading aviation institutions worldwide.

## Key Topics

- EASA Certification
- ATPL (Airline Transport Pilot)
- CPL (Commercial Pilot License)
- Pilot Training
- Cabin Crew Training
- Aircraft Maintenance
- Flight Simulators
- Diamond Aircraft Fleet
- Aviation Academy
- International Locations
- CASA Approval
- Flight School
- Aviation Education
- ESMA Montpellier
- Academic Partnerships

## Core Training Programs

- [Aviation Training Programs](https://www.airwaysaviation.com/programs): Comprehensive EASA-approved programs for airline pilots, cabin crew, and technicians
- [Amelia Online Program](https://www.airwaysaviation.com/amelia-online-program): Self-paced online learning platform for pilot and cabin crew training courses
- [Fleet & Simulators](https://www.airwaysaviation.com/fleet-simulators): Details on Diamond Aircraft fleet and advanced flight simulators for training

## Global Training Locations

- [Airways Aviation France - ESMA](https://www.airwaysaviation.com/country/france): ESMA aviation training in Montpellier with pilot, cabin crew, and maintenance courses
- [Airways Aviation Australia](https://www.airwaysaviation.com/country/australia): CASA Part 141/142 approved aviation training in Australian locations
- [Airways Aviation UAE](https://www.airwaysaviation.com/country/uae): Dubai-based CPL and ATPL pilot training programs with simulator facilities
- [Airways Aviation India](https://www.airwaysaviation.com/country/india): Hyderabad aviation theory school with DGCA exam prep and pilot foundation courses
- [Airways Aviation Portugal](https://www.airwaysaviation.com/country/portugal): Cascais-based aviation academy with ATPL courses and modern training facilities
- [Airways Aviation Italy](https://www.airwaysaviation.com/country/italy): Professione Volare partnership offering pilot training and fleet in Forli, Italy
- [Airways Aviation Nordics](https://www.airwaysaviation.com/country/nordic): Nordic region flight academy with Patria Pilot Training partnership in Finland
- [Airways Aviation Morocco](https://www.airwaysaviation.com/country/morocco): EASA-approved Casablanca academy offering fixed and rotary-wing training
- [Airways Aviation Cabo Verde](https://www.airwaysaviation.com/country/caboverde): Regional aviation academy in Cabo Verde with pilot training and maintenance courses
